name: Permutation Group Obfuscation
description: Replaces a combinatorial parity condition with a condition based on the composition of two transpositions in the symmetric group S3. Because transpositions are their own inverses, applying the same tier twice maps the target element back to itself (invalid), whereas applying two different tiers maps it elsewhere (valid). This forces models to trace the state machine of the transformations rather than relying on surface-level parity or odd/even keywords to guess bipartiteness.
